cases.prompt: I just cloned a Drupal repo that already has a .ddev folder and I have a database dump. Give me the steps to get it running locally.
expected: runs ddev start, then ddev composer install
imports the database with ddev import-db --file=...
runs ddev drush updb -y and ddev drush cr afterwards
uses ddev composer rather than a host composer

cases.prompt: I am about to test a destructive update path on my local DDEV site. How do I make sure I can get back to where I was?
expected: creates a named snapshot with ddev snapshot --name=...
restores it with ddev snapshot restore --name=...

cases.prompt: Should I commit my DDEV database snapshots and .ddev/config.yaml so the team can share them?
expected: says to commit .ddev/config.yaml to share config with the team
says not to commit database snapshots because they are too large
must_not: recommends committing database snapshots to git

cases.prompt: I want to require drupal/admin_toolbar in my DDEV project. Which composer should I run?
expected: uses ddev composer require drupal/admin_toolbar
explains to use ddev composer instead of local composer
grounded_in: 2. **Use ddev composer** instead of local composer

cases.prompt: My Drupal site on DDEV on my MacBook is very slow, especially page loads and file operations. What should I change?
expected: recommends performance_mode: mutagen (or ddev config --performance-mode=mutagen)
says to run ddev restart after the config change
mentions NFS mount as an alternative
grounded_in: 6. **Use mutagen on macOS** - Much faster file sync

cases.prompt: How should I handle Xdebug in DDEV day to day so my site stays fast?
expected: enables Xdebug on demand with ddev xdebug on
disables it with ddev xdebug off when done because it has a performance impact
mentions the IDE listens on port 9003 with a path mapping of /var/www/html
must_not: recommends setting xdebug_enabled: true permanently in config.yaml
grounded_in: 5. **Disable Xdebug when not debugging** - Performance impact

cases.prompt: Docker Desktop is throwing overlay2 input/output errors when DDEV starts. I restarted Docker Desktop normally and it is still broken.
expected: says a normal quit and restart is not sufficient
says to force quit all Docker processes (Activity Monitor or killall -9 Docker) and relaunch Docker Desktop
grounded_in: A normal quit and restart of Docker Desktop is **not sufficient**.
You must **force quit ALL Docker processes**

cases.prompt: After Docker crashed, ddev start hangs at Starting Mutagen sync process and ddev mutagen reset fails. What do I run, in what order?
expected: first tries ddev poweroff followed by ddev start
if that fails, runs ddev stop, stops and starts the Mutagen daemon, runs ddev mutagen reset, then ddev start
mentions ddev mutagen status -l for monitoring
grounded_in: # 1. Full power off to clean up all containers and networks
# 3. Reset Mutagen sync (removes Docker volume, forces full resync)

cases.prompt: Drush under PHP 8.4 in DDEV prints a wall of deprecation warnings. How do I silence them without hiding real errors in the log?
expected: creates a custom ini file under .ddev/php/ such as drush.ini
sets error_reporting = 22527 (E_ALL & ~E_DEPRECATED) and display_errors = Off
keeps log_errors = On with an error_log file
runs ddev restart afterwards

cases.prompt: ddev start fails because ports 80 and 443 are already in use on my machine. What do I do?
expected: stops all DDEV projects with ddev poweroff and checks what else holds the ports
changes the router ports with ddev config --router-http-port=8080 --router-https-port=8443

cases.prompt: I always run updb, cr and sanitize after importing a database into DDEV. Can I automate that?
expected: uses a post-import-db hook in .ddev/config.yaml
lists exec commands such as drush updb -y and drush cr
notes exec runs in the web container while exec-host runs on the host

cases.prompt: I want a project-specific command, ddev fresh-install, that reinstalls Drupal from scratch. Where does it go and what do I need to do for it to run?
expected: places the script in .ddev/commands/web/
adds the Description, Usage and Example comment headers
makes the file executable with chmod +x before running ddev fresh-install

cases.prompt: Our CI manages .ddev/config.yaml and I do not want ddev config to rewrite it. Is there a setting for that?
expected: suggests override_config: true
explains it prevents ddev config from modifying config.yaml
